results.collectionCensoredName: The Sojourn | Season Two - Volume Three: The Wolf and the Raven | Cassandra | In the Forests of the Night
results.description:
Caveat Emptor

In the wake of Elizabeth Ancelet’s fateful meeting with Empress Valendra, the Tantalus Cluster once more stands on the brink of war. As countless competing agendas vie for influence over Elizabeth and her desperate peace initiative, the crew of the Guinevere are tested to the limits of their fellowship. Meanwhile, in the Cluster’s darkest corners, the cunning Admiral Farren carefully arranges his pieces to make a decisive move…

Grounded in a rich sci-fi universe inspired by the age of sail, The Sojourn is an epic interstellar adventure told entirely through audio, with a cast of veteran voice actors, immersive sound effects, and a sweeping original soundtrack. 

“The Sojourn is a melange of rich storytelling, superb sound effects, and well-written characters that sound so real it's like you're in the shuttle beside them. There's a lot to enjoy in this immersive, fun audiodrama." - Jeremy Szal

“It's my first audiodrama and it sets the bar very high! Really high quality sound effects and talented voice actors bring the story to life like nothing else.” - Matterbeam, ToughSF

Starring Larissa Thompson as Captain Cassandra Farren, Emily Serdahl as Doctor Elizabeth Ancelet, Laura Faye Smith as Tamara Melari, and Ben Prendergast as Mathias Croft, also featuring Angus Miller as Edwin Faulkner and Dominic Keating as Fleet Admiral Darius Farren. Written by Daniel Orrett, Rowan J. Coleman, and Larissa Thompson with sound design by Kennedy Phillips and Dave Chick, and music by Sam Redfern.

Transcripts available here: https://www.thesojournaudiodrama.com/transcripts
